features.title: Identify guest and retrieve current booking
features.user_visible_behavior: The voice agent confirms the guest's name spelling or collects a confirmation number, confirms whether check-in is today or an earlier New York date, and retrieves the matching current reservation from the selected Nolita or Nap York Mews account.

acceptance_criteria: The agent waits for trusted property context, one confirmed lookup key, and a confirmed check-in date before lookup.
Name lookup reads back spelling for confirmation or asks the guest to spell an unclear name.
The backend maps the allowlisted property to only its configured Mews credentials and rejects unauthorized agent requests.
Confirmation-number and exact normalized-name lookup return explicit matched, no-match, ambiguous, or unavailable outcomes.
Current reservations include eligible Started or Confirmed bookings on the supplied New York local check-in date; cancelled and processed bookings are excluded.
Mews credentials and raw responses are not exposed in frontend, voice output, or logs.
Automated backend and voice-agent tests pass, and setup/integration documentation is current.
